title: Export AD CS issues to CSV with Locksmith Mode 2
summary: Install the Locksmith module from the PowerShell Gallery and run a read-only Mode 2 scan that writes discovered AD CS issues to ADCSIssues.CSV.
code:
Install-Module -Name Locksmith -Scope CurrentUser
Import-Module Locksmith
# Domain-joined host with the ActiveDirectory and ServerManager modules.
# Mode 2 writes ADCSIssues.CSV in the current directory and does not apply fixes.
Invoke-Locksmith -Mode 2
notes: Run only against forests you own or have written permission to assess.
Mode 2 and Mode 3 export findings; do not use Mode 4 (fix all issues) in production.
Some checks need administrative rights. A standard-user run can miss CA-level findings such as ESC6 and ESC7.
